limits: Wire controls reconstruct packet bytes from retained decoded payloads. Segment packetization, fixed 2048-byte reads and 20ms timing are synthetic, not original USB traffic.
Native DLL/device, camera, MediaPipe and SDK are absent. Offscreen paintEvent completion is not DWM presentation.
Decoded and wire controls include different verification work. One run per case is not a calibrated perturbation or statistical performance comparison.
Source reader thread CPU includes parser, assembler, synchronous signal delivery and verification, not pure protocol cost; no GIL/CPU percentages are inferred.
Signed nominal phase offsets follow chunk-start pacing and are not causal waits. Actual same-event stages retain the original causality gates.

Qt binding and Qt major version change together. This small fixed matrix neither isolates a binding implementation mechanism nor calibrates live desktop/camera/SDK performance. Session 0 / offscreen is not Session 1 / windows.
Direct callback controls validate normal-path delivery only; production exception, disconnect and lifecycle behavior is not certified. No production deployment or latency percentage claim follows.
